|colspan="6" align="left"|'''Notes:'''<br />
{{refbegin}}
{{note|elim|1}} Joëlle and Anthony were eliminated on Day 1 for losing the first challenge.<br />
{{note|tie|2}} Per the rules of ''Koh-Lanta'', in the event of a deadlocked tie, the tied castaways would draw rocks. The castaway that<br />draws the black rock would be eliminated.<br />
{{note|reward|3}} The reward was played out in two challenges. Koror won the first challenge, which afforded them luxuries on their trek.<br />The result of the trek, the second challenge, resulted in a tie.<br />
{{note|ambassador|4}} At the ambassadors meeting, Fabienne and Isabelle had to vote on one castaway to eliminate. They both decided<br />to vote out Alexandre.<br />
{{note|immunity|5}} Christina kept her immunity she won on Day 18 for the Tribal Council on Day 21, since the Tribal Council she was<br />supposed to be immune at was cancelled.<br />
{{note|final4|6}} At the final four, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge. Fabienne came in last and was<br />eliminated.
{{refend}}
